Config.EnabledHint: Show this tile in Terrain Destruction Mode and allow it to cycle through destroyed states.
Config.PlatformHint: On the final destroyed state, choose Tokens on every Level assigned to this Tile to fall to each Level below.
Config.PlatformMessageHint: Optional text shown in Chat when this platform reaches its final destroyed state. Leave blank to omit this sentence.
Config.BlocksMovementHint: Prevent token movement across the opaque silhouette while the tile is not fully destroyed.
Config.BlocksVisionHint: Use one terrain-wall envelope for light, darkness, and sight so the entire tile remains visible while blocking what is behind it.
Config.StatesHint: Add images in damage order. For the best effect, use images with the same dimensions. The last image is the fully destroyed state. Leave an image empty to hide the tile at that stage.
Config.RestoreBeforeDefinitionChange: Restore damaged tiles before changing their base image, platform settings, or destruction sequence.
